LightningComponentBundle.description: Floating chat window that answers property questions with picture cards - hero image, gallery, specifications, documents and the advisor to call.

property.name: agentTagline
property.label: Agent Status Line
property.description: Small line under the agent name.

property.name: brandName
property.label: Brand Monogram
property.description: Two or three letters set in the avatar circle and the launcher.

property.name: welcomeMessage
property.label: Welcome Message
property.default: Hello! I am your Property Consultant. Tell me a city, a configuration or a budget and I will pull up the residences with photographs.

property.name: launcherLabel
property.label: Launcher Label
property.description: Text on the closed floating button. Hidden on small screens.

property.name: openOnLoad
property.label: Open On Page Load
property.description: Opens the window automatically. Leave off so the page is not taken over.
